peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 12.4% below its local comparables; 14 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (98.1): 7.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 106 of 108 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 83.3% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2010.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $838,000 ($1,366 psf, 613 sq ft; 17 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,482 psf (range $1,447–1,769); 7.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $71,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $1,165,000 ($1,356 psf, 850–882 sq ft; 10 resales, Sep 2024–Aug 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,634 psf (range $1,490–1,926); 17% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $239,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Bukit Panjang MRT about 40 m, Phoenix LRT about 270 m; closer than 116 of 116 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest West View Primary School about 360 m; more than 39 of 116 similar developments (the same as 35). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 40 m), more than 106 of 116 similar developments (the same as 6); nearest hawker centre Senja Hawker Centre about 760 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 180 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Arden, 3 new sales, about 490 m; The Myst, 46 new sales, about 910 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 28 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 49 new sales and 423 resales (472 purchases); new sales were 10.4% of these purchases. Subsales (1) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dairy Farm Walk GLS site (Jan 2026) (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,970 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 423 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 59 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 423 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 483 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−12.4%). Planning-area private resales −24.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
